prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right one depends on your location in Houston, budget, speed needs, and whether it’s a simple repair or a major replacement. That said, several well‑reviewed companies in Houston you can start with are:

- John Moore Services (large, local, long track record)
- Abacus Plumbing, AC & Electric (good reputation for residential service)
- ARS/Rescue Rooter (national franchisor with local crews)
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchisees with quick‑service promise)

How to pick the best for your job
1. Verify licensing and insurance — Texas HVAC contractors are licensed through TDLR; ask for the license number and confirm it.  
2. Look for NATE‑certified technicians and an A/B BBB rating.  
3. Read recent Google/Yelp/Angi reviews for projects like yours (AC repair, not installs).  
4. Ask about flat diagnostic fees, upfront written estimates, labor & parts warranties, and emergency/after‑hours costs.  
5. Get at least 2–3 estimates for comparable repairs.  
6. Ask whether they’ll pull required permits and whether the tech will explain the cause (not just replace parts).  

If you want, tell me your zip code or the neighborhood and whether you need emergency same‑day service — I can pull up top local options and recent ratings or give a shortlist and a script of questions to ask when you call.
